description: Imports et exports commerciaux (2005 à 2025) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Imports et exports commerciaux (MWh), au pas horaire depuis 2005, entre la France et chacun des pays avec lesquels elle partage des interconnexions: Grande-Bretagne, Suisse, Italie, Espagne, zone CWE (Allemagne, Autriche, Belgique, Luxembourg, Pays-Bas). Les échanges commerciaux représentent les échanges contractuels entre pays. Ils ne doivent pas être confondus avec les échanges physiques. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marchés. Its keywords are Interconnexion, Bilan annuel. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
